title: Understanding the Histogram
text: The histogram shows the distribution of the bootstrap sample proportions. The dashed lines indicate the 95% confidence interval for the true proportion $$p$$.

title: Position of the Original Sample Proportion
text: The original sample proportion \( \hat{\alpha} $$=$$ $$0.67$$ \) is located within the 95% confidence interval shown in the histogram.

title: Interpreting the Confidence Interval
text: A 95% confidence interval means that if we were to take many samples and build a confidence interval from each of them, 95% of those intervals would contain the true proportion $$p$$.

title: Conclusion from the Histogram
text: Given that \( \hat{\alpha} $$=$$ $$0.67$$ \) is within the 95% confidence interval, what can we conclude about the true proportion $$p$$?
